appDescription: Uses the user's music taste and saved scenes to coordinate music selection and supported cabin ambient lighting.

function.name: SET_MOOD
function.description: Selects music settings and requests supported cabin lighting for a built-in or user-saved mood, limited to the requested target.

mood.description: The built-in mood identifier calm, uplift, or familiar, or the exact name of a user-saved mood.

target.description: The scene components to change; defaults to all when omitted.

function.name: ADJUST_MOOD
function.description: Makes a small relative adjustment to music or cabin lighting while leaving the other component unchanged.

target.description: The scene component to adjust; the other component must remain unchanged.

dimension.description: Music supports energy or brightness; lighting supports brightness or color.

direction.description: Required for energy or brightness adjustments; omitted for color changes.

color.description: Required for lighting color changes; a six-digit hexadecimal RGB color with a leading hash.

function.name: SAVE_MOOD
function.description: Saves current music settings and requested cabin lighting under a user-provided name for later recall.

name.description: The name assigned by the user to the current mood settings.
